title: This release did not pass its checks
body: The release's files did not pass their checks, so nothing of them is used (checksum: manifest.json doesn't match SHA256SUMS).

Fetch the release again from https://omamobile.org/download. If it fails the same way, the files are not the ones Omarchy Mobile signed: don't install them, and tell us at https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: Nothing was sent to a phone.
Start the installer again once that is done.
